title: The Order #1 Steve McNiven Variant Cover Marvel 2007 The Initiative Fraction
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Order #1 (2007), Marvel Comics - Steve McNiven variant edition (1B). The Initiative tie-in, written by Matt Fraction, art by Barry Kitson. Rated T+. $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: Fantastic Four "got milk?" ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
